gaps.sentence: Scarcely had the anthem finished ___ the crowd invaded the pitch.
Should you ___ any problems, call reception immediately.
gaps.explanation: Should you experience… = If you experience… — formal conditional inversion.

gaps.sentence: Such ___ the demand for tickets that the website crashed.
gaps.explanation: Such was the demand that… — emphatic result structure.

gaps.sentence: Only by training every day ___ she hope to qualify.
gaps.explanation: 'Only by training every day could she hope …' — inverted modal.

gaps.sentence: At no point ___ the pilot leave the cockpit.
gaps.explanation: At no point did… = never did… — negative adverbial inversion.

gaps.sentence: Only by practising daily ___ you improve your fluency.
gaps.explanation: Only by doing X will you… — future inversion after only by.

gaps.sentence: Never have I ___ such a stubborn refusal.
gaps.explanation: Inversion: Never have I + past participle — never adds emphasis.

gaps.sentence: No sooner had he sat down ___ the phone rang.
gaps.explanation: No sooner … than — fixed pair with inversion after 'no sooner'.
